entries.message: This update includes stop Trakt JSON imports adding unrelated movies from show summaries, add tracker write review, explicit library monitoring, faster background sync and clearer sync retries, review skipped Simkl episodes, redesign manual watch review and sync watches across library copies, expand remote backup destinations and restore controls, add the public Plekt privacy policy, and compress encrypted full backups.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Importing every file from a Trakt export no longer adds a random, unrelated movie for each show. The per-show summaries in watched-shows.json are now skipped instead of being read as movies that carried the show's TMDB number.
Trakt collection files are no longer imported as watches, so movies you own but have not watched stay unwatched.
Sync Activity groups held Trakt and Simkl writes by movie or show, with episode and provider details inside each group
Recheck all checks eligible held writes against tracker history and reports how many holds cleared and how many remain
Cancel pending updates removes held watch updates for the selected movies and shows after confirmation, keeping local and tracker watch history
Simkl rechecks due held watches in batches of up to 100 and clears a hold only when Simkl reports the same item at the same watch time
Retry failed shows the watch action, the affected apps and their recorded errors before retrying, then keeps the popup open with the result and any new app errors
Retry failed now covers Simkl: a Simkl update that was never sent because the watch arrived without IDs is queued again with the resolved IDs
A refused retry shows the server's reason instead of a generic failure, and Retry is only offered for apps that can be retried
Manual Watch Review lets you select items to see proposed watch dates, pick a date or mark an item unwatched, and confirm the selected decisions together
Episode watch-date suggestions in Manual Watch Review show which neighbouring episode the date was based on
Add library monitoring controls and bulk manual watch review
Show the zero-library warning banner on cold loads to Dashboard and every non-Settings route, and fix its mobile height at narrow widths
On desktop, the "No libraries selected" banner sits in its own row above the Dashboard instead of filling the page and squashing the four sections

Enforce explicit library selection across resume, Next Up, personal rating scans and writes, Jellyfin resume checks, unwatched fallback polls, live session completion, scoped Force Sync, and manual retry routes

Scope personal rating baselines and Force Sync plan staleness to the library selection revision so deselecting a library never triggers synthetic clears, strip portable backup library selections on restore, and harden plugin LibraryContext validation
Changing which libraries are selected takes effect immediately for library membership checks
A Plex library selected while Plekt is running is checked for manual watched marks on the next poll, instead of up to an hour later
A manual watched mark made in Plex just before a settings save is no longer skipped when the background check restarts
Improve Up Next provider feed sync, Mirror mode ordering and safe hide passes, per-show override controls, Dashboard recovery, and settings dialog focus and session guards
Opening per-show Up Next options no longer throws an error on show pages
Plex, Emby and Jellyfin catch-up imports, library availability checks and resume to Next Up chains run in parallel, so a three-server catch-up finishes several times faster without duplicate watches
Recent-watch imports recheck the item inside one database transaction, so two servers reporting the same watch at once record it only once
Up Next builds, show progress updates, settings loads and the pending sync sweep do far less repeated work, so the dashboard and background ticks stay quicker on large libraries
Sync Activity keeps every row, retry and dismissal, but trims recognized raw request and response bodies after 90 days to stop the database growing
Sync Activity stops its periodic refresh while the browser tab is hidden and refreshes when you return
Season details on show pages lay out with fewer reflows, keeping wrapped episode heights exact

Fix Force Sync episode matching, watch dates, plexHistoricalWatchedSync enforcement, Trakt durable retry loops, queued-retry outcome preservation, Simkl batch quota lock release, Plex movie fallback matching, episode personal rating series IDs, Plex WebSocket subpath preservation, and cross-process cache version bumps

Isolate multi-tenant in-memory state, watch-history backup folders, tenant artwork restores, and activeUser browser caches; block secret reuse on server URL changes, add DNS metadata-IP pinning, encrypt backup passphrases and remote destination secrets at rest, strip calendarFeedToken from portable exports, and sanitize frontend URLs and CSS backdrops

Fix dropped-only show detail visibility, sign-out and sign-in live update SSE lifecycle with backoff, stuck action buttons, stale detail render races, listener and poller leaks, and Up Next controls including per-show options, Now Playing reorder bindings, and Mirror order and hide safety
Document that Emby 4.9.5.0 and 4.10.1.0 both accept rating writes without storing them and that Plekt reads back to report the failure
Add two-way dropped-title sync notes for Trakt (shows) and Simkl (shows and movies), and include YouTube and optional AniDB in the Metadata sources overview
Add provider support matrix docs and migration 64 SQLite poster cache and TVDB expression indexes
Shows with episodes skipped for Simkl because of alternate numbering now offer Review Simkl updates in Sync Activity
The review matches each skipped watch to a Simkl episode by title and air date, and only exact matches with the same aired numbering can be sent
Selected watches go to Simkl with their saved dates through the normal batch, backup, quota and readback checks, and their Sync Activity status updates
The held tracker write panel is now Watch updates on hold, with Check watch status and Cancel selected updates
Sync Activity results explain Simkl alternate-order skips in plain words
The Episode order dialog explains that Simkl receives watches it can match in both catalogues
Find matching Jellyfin and Emby episode copies when Up Next has seen only one copy
Repair missed episode watches during scheduled catch-up after verifying the series identity
Retry Emby and Jellyfin watch and progress updates with a fresh lookup when a saved item ID no longer exists
Keep watch source and sync results visible in Media Info and include the newest 2,000 matching audit events in the export
Redesign Manual Watch review with inline date-option buttons, collapsed season groups, flush show posters, top-right Dismiss and bottom-right Confirm watched without a second confirmation popup
Process bulk Manual Watch review confirmations and dismissals in a single background server request so leaving or refreshing the page no longer abandons pending items
Preserve provider item provenance on Manual Watch review approvals and Plex notification lookups so queued Simkl writes pass library checks and settle reliably
Update Sync Activity rows cleanly when queued Simkl writes settle, cancel, or require review, preventing stale pending states and misleading empty-target summaries
Simplify the Clear progress confirmation copy with an inline media preview and match confirmation dialogs to the site's dark and light modal theme
Add Dropbox sign-in, S3-compatible storage, WebDAV, and external folders alongside Backblaze B2 in Settings and guided setup.
Configure watch-history and encrypted full backups independently per destination, with retention overrides, upload status, and on-demand backups. Dropbox keeps two full backups by default.
Show local and remote backup help beside the corresponding settings, with provider-specific setup guides.
Group remote restore results by enabled destination and show refresh controls and per-location errors.
Stream large uploads to Dropbox, WebDAV, and the OneDrive adapter. Use resumable uploads for large OneDrive files.
Migrate existing local full backups to the Plekt-named folder at startup.
Explain how self-hosted data, connected services, backups, install metrics, and public analytics are handled.
Provide a public privacy policy URL for the Dropbox backup integration.
Encrypted full backups are now compressed and about 19 times smaller (one 943 MB backup became 50 MB), so local storage and remote uploads use far less space and time
Older backups still restore. Full backups made with this version can't be restored by older Plekt releases, so keep a pre-upgrade backup if you might roll back
A full backup that decrypts but can't be decompressed now stops with a clear damaged-file error before anything is restored
